q: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors, integrated circuits and microchips, and also with the behaviour and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor or vacuum is known as _____.
e: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors, integrated circuits and microchips, and also with the behaviour and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor or vacuum is known as electronics. Put mechanics or thermodynamics in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Electronics is about controlling electrons in semiconductors, tubes, and chips.

q: Active electrical components are vacuum tubes, transistors, diodes, ICs, TRIACs, SCRs, LEDs, etc. and requires a _____ source to operate.
e: Active electrical components are vacuum tubes, transistors, diodes, ICs, TRIACs, SCRs, LEDs, etc. and requires a power source to operate. Put voltage or current in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A diode lets current through one way and blocks the other, the pn junction rectifier.

q: Passive electrical components are capable of operating without an _____ power source.
e: Passive electrical components are capable of operating without an external power source. Put internal or alternating in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Passive parts need no extra power source; they cannot add energy to the signal.

q: Zener diode is a _____ doped semiconductor (silicon or germanium) pn junction diode.
e: Zener diode is a heavily doped semiconductor (silicon or germanium) pn junction diode. Put lightly or moderately in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A zener is heavily doped so reverse breakdown is sharp and usable as a voltage clamp. A diode lets current through one way and blocks the other, the pn junction rectifier.

q: When the voltage across the terminals of a zener diode is reversed and the potential reaches the zener voltage, the junction breaks down and the current flows in the _____ direction.
e: When the voltage across the terminals of a zener diode is reversed and the potential reaches the zener voltage, the junction breaks down and the current flows in the reverse direction. Put forward or lateral in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: When the potential reaches the zener voltage (breakdown voltage or _____ voltage), the junction breaks down.
e: When the potential reaches the zener voltage (breakdown voltage or knee voltage), the junction breaks down. peak is not knee, and threshold is not knee either. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points.

q: Avalanche breakdown occurs at junctions which being lightly doped have _____ depletion layers.
e: Avalanche breakdown occurs at junctions which being lightly doped have wide depletion layers. Put narrow or thin in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Avalanche breakdown occurs at junctions which being lightly doped have _____ depletion layers. wide.

q: Zener breakdown occurs at junctions which being heavily doped have _____ depletion layers.
e: Zener breakdown occurs at junctions which being heavily doped have narrow depletion layers. Put wide or thick in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A zener is heavily doped so reverse breakdown is sharp and usable as a voltage clamp.

q: The voltage drop across the zener diode always remains _____ irrespective of the applied voltage.
e: The voltage drop across the zener diode always remains constant irrespective of the applied voltage. variable is not constant, and zero is not constant either. A zener is heavily doped so reverse breakdown is sharp and usable as a voltage clamp. A diode lets current through one way and blocks the other, the pn junction rectifier.

q: This feature of the zener diode makes it suitable for voltage regulation as _____ elements.
e: This feature of the zener diode makes it suitable for voltage regulation as reference elements. active and passive belong to other processes, not this reference case. A zener is heavily doped so reverse breakdown is sharp and usable as a voltage clamp. A diode lets current through one way and blocks the other, the pn junction rectifier.

q: A LED is a semiconductor light source capable of emitting a fairly narrow bandwidth of visible (or) invisible light when its internal diode junction attains a forward-biased current (or) _____.
e: A LED is a semiconductor light source capable of emitting a fairly narrow bandwidth of visible (or) invisible light when its internal diode junction attains a forward-biased current (or) voltage. Put resistance or capacitance in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: LEDs do not directly produce white light but use a blue LED with a phosphor coating to convert blue light to white light by a process called _____.
e: LEDs do not directly produce white light but use a blue LED with a phosphor coating to convert blue light to white light by a process called fluorescence. Put incandescence or phosphorescence in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. An LED emits a narrow band of light when forward current crosses the junction.

q: A current limiting resistor should be connected in _____ with LED in the circuit to protect the LED.
e: A current limiting resistor should be connected in series with LED in the circuit to protect the LED. parallel is not series, and series-parallel is not series either. An LED emits a narrow band of light when forward current crosses the junction.

q: Fast action and no warmup time is an advantage of LED, and the response time is about _____ ns.
e: Fast action and no warmup time is an advantage of LED, and the response time is about 10 ns. 50 is not 10, and 100 is not 10 either. An LED emits a narrow band of light when forward current crosses the junction.

q: A photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts light into _____ current.
e: A photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts light into electrical current. Put magnetic or thermal in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path. A photodiode turns light into current; reverse bias is the usual sensing mode.

q: Photodiodes work in _____ biased mode.
e: Photodiodes work in reverse biased mode. forward is not reverse, and zero is not reverse either. A photodiode turns light into current; reverse bias is the usual sensing mode.

q: When the photodiode is illuminated with light (photons) of energy $hv$ greater than the energy gap $E_g$ of the semiconductor, then _____ pairs are generated.
e: When the photodiode is illuminated with light (photons) of energy hv greater than the energy gap Eg of the semiconductor, then electron-hole pairs are generated. proton-neutron and ion-electron belong to other processes, not this electron-hole case. Einstein's 1905 photon is the particle side of light, energy hf. In metals the mobile carriers are electrons, drifting opposite the conventional-current arrow.

q: A small amount of current, due to the flow of minority carriers, is also produced when no light is falling and is called _____ current.
e: A small amount of current, due to the flow of minority carriers, is also produced when no light is falling and is called dark current. bright is not dark, and leakage is not dark either. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: A light dependent resistor (LDR) is a light controlled _____ resistor.
e: A light dependent resistor (LDR) is a light controlled variable resistor. Put fixed or linear in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. An LDR drops resistance as light rises, so it is a light-controlled resistor.

q: Special semiconductor crystal, such as cadmium sulfide (or) _____ sulfide is used to make photo resistors.
e: Special semiconductor crystal, such as cadmium sulfide (or) lead sulfide is used to make photo resistors. copper is not lead, and zinc is not lead either. Semiconductor behaviour sits between conductor and insulator and is doping-tunable.

q: A thermistor is a temperature sensor that exhibits a large change in resistance proportional to a change in _____.
e: A thermistor is a temperature sensor that exhibits a large change in resistance proportional to a change in temperature. voltage and light belong to other processes, not this temperature case. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat.

q: In the Negative Temperature Coefficient (NTC) thermistor, the resistance _____ as the temperature increases.
e: In the Negative Temperature Coefficient (NTC) thermistor, the resistance decreases as the temperature increases. increases is not decreases, and remains constant is not decreases either. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat.

q: In the Positive Temperature Coefficient (PTC) thermistor, the resistance increases as the temperature increases, and is used to break the circuit at _____ temperatures.
e: In the Positive Temperature Coefficient (PTC) thermistor, the resistance increases as the temperature increases, and is used to break the circuit at preset temperatures. random is not preset, and absolute is not preset either. A thermistor's resistance swings hard with temperature, which is how it senses heat.

q: A liquid crystal display (LCD) is a flat-panel display that uses the light-modulating properties of liquid crystals combined with _____.
e: A liquid crystal display (LCD) is a flat-panel display that uses the light-modulating properties of liquid crystals combined with polarizers. Put capacitors or inductors in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. An LCD twists polarized light through a liquid-crystal layer instead of emitting light. Liquid crystals sit between ordinary liquids and solid crystals in their molecular order.

q: Liquid crystals do not emit light directly, instead using a backlight or _____ to produce images in color or monochrome.
e: Liquid crystals do not emit light directly, instead using a backlight or reflector to produce images in color or monochrome. absorber is not reflector, and emitter is not reflector either. Liquid crystals sit between ordinary liquids and solid crystals in their molecular order.

q: LCDs consume much less power than LEDs and gas-plasma displays because they work on the principle of _____ light rather than emitting it.
e: LCDs consume much less power than LEDs and gas-plasma displays because they work on the principle of blocking light rather than emitting it. amplifying is not blocking, and refracting is not blocking either. Work on the principle of _____ light rather than emitting it. blocking.

q: The main difference between a zener diode and a normal diode lies in the passage of current, where a normal diode allows current to flow only in one direction while zener diode allows current to flow in both _____.
e: The main difference between a zener diode and a normal diode lies in the passage of current, where a normal diode allows current to flow only in one direction while zener diode allows current to flow in both directions. Put polarities or phases in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: For normal operation of a zener diode, in breakdown region, the current through the diode should be limited by an external _____.
e: For normal operation of a zener diode, in breakdown region, the current through the diode should be limited by an external battery. Put circuit or capacitor in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A diode lets current through one way and blocks the other, the pn junction rectifier. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: The voltage drop feature makes the zener diode suitable for voltage regulation as reference elements, surge suppressors, and in switching applications and _____ circuits.
e: The voltage drop feature makes the zener diode suitable for voltage regulation as reference elements, surge suppressors, and in switching applications and clipper circuits. amplifier is not clipper, and oscillator is not clipper either. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points.
